# Slides commands a plugin may run

87 of the 324 Slides registry commands are on the allowlist (docs/plugins.md section 6a). `read` ids need `document = "read"`, every other id `document = "write"`. `params` is the registry's own description of the parameters; a `run` whose params hold a key named `path`, `dir`, `file`, `url`, `uri`, `href` or `src`, or a denied key of the list, is refused.

## `document.`

| Id | Access | Label | Params |
|---|---|---|---|
| `document.inspect` | read | Inspect Presentation | `{} → slides with titles, layouts, shape counts; selection; size; theme` |

## `selection.`

| Id | Access | Label | Params |
|---|---|---|---|
| `selection.hideAll` | write | Hide All | `{} hides every top-level object on the slide` |
| `selection.select` | write | Select | `{ids \| id, toggle?: bool (Ctrl+click), add?: bool} → {selected}: objects in groups too; a hidden object picked from the list is shown` |
| `selection.showAll` | write | Show All | `{} shows every object on the slide, inside groups too` |

## `text.`

| Id | Access | Label | Params |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text.autocorrect` | write | AutoCorrect Options | `{on?, twoInitials?, sentenceCaps?, days?, capsLock?, fractions?, ordinals?: bool, add?: [from, to], remove?: from} → the options and the replacement list` |
| `text.commit` | write | Commit Composition | `{text} — the input method's result replaces its composition, as one undo step` |
| `text.compose` | write | Compose Text | `{text, active?: [start, end]} — an input method's composition (preedit) at the insertion point; empty text cancels it` |
| `text.delete` | write | Delete Text | `{dir?: backward\|forward\|wordBackward\|wordForward} — the word directions are Ctrl+Backspace/Delete: they work from the start of a selection without deleting it` |
| `text.edit` | write | Edit Text | `{id?, at?: [paragraph, char], end?: bool, cell?: [row, col], notes?: bool}` |
| `text.exit` | write | Stop Editing Text | `{}` |
| `text.find` | write | Find | `{text, matchCase?: bool, wholeWords?: bool} → [{slide, shape (null = notes), cell?: [row, col], para, start, end}] (char offsets in the paragraph)` |
| `text.get` | write | Get Text | `{id?} → {text, paragraphs}` |
| `text.insert` | write | Type Text | `{text} (\n = new paragraph, \u000b = line break)` |
| `text.move` | write | Move Insertion Point | `{to: left\|right\|up\|down\|wordLeft\|wordRight\|lineStart\|lineEnd\|paraStart\|paraEnd\|paraUp\|paraDown\|start\|end, extend?: bool} — left/right are on screen: in a right-to-left paragraph left goes forward` |
| `text.replace` | write | Replace | `{text, with, matchCase?, wholeWords?, at?: a text.find match (replace just that one; default: replace all)} → {replaced}` |
| `text.select` | write | Select Text | `{anchor: [p, c], caret: [p, c]}` |
| `text.selectAll` | write | Select All Text | `{}` |
| `text.selectParagraph` | write | Select Paragraph | `{at?: [p, c]}` |
| `text.selectWord` | write | Select Word | `{at?: [p, c]}` |
| `text.set` | write | Set Text | `{id?, text, cell?: [r, c]} — replaces the whole text, keeping the first run's formatting` |
